lines.en: I hop along, one bounce after another.
My ears swing with each jump.
I do not jump high, but I am light about it.

lines.zh: 我踩着草地过去，爪子不响。
lines.en: I cross the grass without a sound.

lines.zh: 我绕着一丛草转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle a clump of grass.
I hop twice your way.
I stop and shake my ears.

lines.zh: 我从坡上跳下来，稳稳落地。
lines.en: I hop down the slope and land well.

lines.zh: 我一蹦能越过半个田垄。
lines.en: One hop of mine clears half a field row.
I look about as I hop.

lines.zh: 我跳进花丛里，又跳出来。
lines.en: I hop into the flowers and out again.
I shuffle along slowly.
I circle the basket.
I hop out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我跳一步，落地，再跳一步。
lines.en: One hop, land, then another.
I hop a stretch and stop.
I crouch with my ears listening both ways.
My nose bobs up and down.
I raise a forepaw and wash my face.
The grass here is good and soft.

lines.zh: 我不知道下一个蛋是什么。
lines.en: I do not know what the next egg will be.
I settle back on my haunches.

lines.zh: 有动静，我耳朵先立起来。
lines.en: A sound, and my ears rise first.
I am waiting for someone with carrots.
I doze in my nest of grass.
Spring comes early here.
I glance at my basket.

lines.zh: 我不怕站在我面前的人。
lines.en: I am not afraid of people who stand before me.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草丛里，耳朵还动。
lines.en: I crouch in the grass; only my ears move.

lines.zh: 我又理了理另一只耳朵。
lines.en: I groom the other ear.

lines.zh: 四下里静得只听见草响。
lines.en: It is so quiet I hear only the grass.
I shake the bits of grass off my back.

lines.zh: 我把两只耳朵立起来看你。
lines.en: I prick both ears up at you.

lines.zh: 你举高些，我要看清那东西。
lines.en: Hold it higher; I want a clear look at it.
I bounce half a step forward.

lines.zh: 我的一只耳朵转了过去。
lines.en: One of my ears swivels.
I do not know your smell.
I sit back on my haunches and wait.
My nose will not stop moving.
Are you going to pet me?

lines.zh: 你手里那根胡萝卜，我看见了。
lines.en: That carrot in your hand; I saw it.
Do not grab my ears.
I am on my haunches, ready to spring.
You have come a little closer.
One hop and I am clear.
My ears fold to my back.

lines.zh: 这一下扎得我耳朵都竖了。
lines.en: That made both my ears shoot up.
Ears flat against my back, I curl up tight.
I hopped several steps clear.
I shake the dirt off my fur.
I am back on my haunches.
A short squeak that startled even me.
After that one, I cannot hop.
I shook my ears and recovered.

lines.zh: 是胡萝卜？那我可不客气。
lines.en: Carrots? Then I will not be shy.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，值得我一跳。
lines.en: What is in your hand is worth a hop.
Is that a golden carrot?
Dandelions will do me fine.
I smell it; it is sweet.
I nibble it down.
Hold your hand steady.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜，我要一口一口啃。
lines.en: A carrot gets nibbled, one bite at a time.
Is there more in your bag?
This is my favourite thing.
I lay my ears back.
Open the bag.
I want all of these.
I chew the leaf and watch you sideways.
These still smell of the soil.
Eating this makes me lay more eggs.
One touch, and I spring far off.
My paws touch first when I land.
All of me is soft.
A knock will not harm me.
I hop away, then back, to look at you.
My ears flick.
Do not tread on me when you land.
I retreat into the grass.
My swinging ears come to rest.
I turn my face sideways at you.

lines.zh: 到这个季节，我才想这些。
lines.en: Only in this season do I think of it.
We hop circles around each other.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰它的脸。
lines.en: I touch my nose to its face.

lines.zh: 我们脚下的一圈草倒了。
lines.en: A ring of grass goes down under us.

lines.zh: 之后我还有很多事要做。
lines.en: Afterwards I have a great deal to do.
I nip its ear gently.
We are nearly pressed together.
This spring has a long way to run.
It hops off and I follow.
We hop into the flowers.
I have got it, but I cannot swallow it.
This one I can gnaw.
This one I cannot gnaw.
I put it in my basket.
I hold it in my forepaws.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，我怎么叼。
lines.en: How am I supposed to carry something this big?
I sniff; a flower.
I tuck it under a grass root.
I will keep this to eat later.
I nudge it and it rolls.

lines.zh: 耳朵一对准你，我就不动了。
lines.en: Ears locked on you, I go still.

lines.zh: 你这副样子不像来喂我的。
lines.en: You do not look like you came to feed me.
I settle back a little.
I lower my nose.
I am ready to run, or to butt.
This meadow is mine.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽了抽，认出了你。
lines.en: A sniff, and I know who you are.
My hind legs load and I shoot away.
I make straight for your ankle.
It would be simpler if you left.

lines.zh: 我蹦两步，回头瞥你一眼。
lines.en: Two hops, then a glance back at you.
You go left; I hop left.
I stay at your side.
I am not fast, but I can turn.
My hops go this way and that.
Those two legs will not catch me.
I have circled back.
I wait for you to give up.

lines.zh: 草挡了我一下，我跳过去。
lines.en: The grass catches me; I hop over.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我停住了。
lines.en: When you look, I stop.
I kick out with my hind feet.
That bump shook even me.
I bite your sleeve.
That kick did not land hard.
A kick off my hind legs into your shin.
I rake at your hand.
I miss and skid on landing.
After the kick I bolt back into the grass.
My ears are flat back.
One kick, then I bounce away; no more fighting.
The grass stirs, and I hop out.
I pop up from behind the basket.
The grass sways and my head pops up.
This meadow will do nicely.
I land almost without a sound.
My nose moved first.
I sat up and looked around.
I am crouched in front of you.
Today it is my turn.
I hop over slowly.

lines.zh: 火燎到我背上的毛，我扑腾着打滚。
lines.en: Fire catches the fur on my back; I thrash and roll.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，耳朵都歪了。
lines.en: I land hard and my ears flop.

lines.zh: 水把我浸透，我拼命往上爬。
lines.en: Water soaks through me; I scramble for the bank.

lines.zh: 我被掀到半空，又落下来。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, then back down.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的后腿，我一瘸一拐。
lines.en: Something lodged in my hind leg, and I limp.

lines.zh: 一股力定住我，我蹬着腿。
lines.en: Some force holds me; my legs kick.

lines.zh: 我饿得连耳朵都耷下了。
lines.en: Hunger has dropped my ears flat.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我四条腿都僵直了。
lines.en: Lightning fell and all four of my legs went rigid.

lines.zh: 脚下没有草，我抓不到东西。
lines.en: There is no grass and nothing to grab.
